capabilities.verb: Discover careers you didn't know exist
capabilities.summary: A structured job catalog you browse as a family tree and a typed relation graph, extendable with AI-generated careers that map onto the same taxonomy.
proofs: Jobs relate through typed edges: similar_to, leads_to, specialises_into, alternative_to, prerequisite_of
Rich structured attributes per job: skills, salary bands, demand outlook, education
AI-generated jobs map onto the existing taxonomy — no free-text orphans

capabilities.verb: See which jobs fit you — and why
capabilities.summary: Any job can get an AI score with positives, negatives and missing prerequisites, your own score sits beside it, and a deterministic fit engine shows the per-dimension breakdown.
proofs: AI scores 0–10 with structured rationale: positives, negatives, missing prerequisites
The deterministic fit engine scores without any AI — per-dimension and re-weightable
Compare 2–4 jobs side by side, per dimension, in the compare tray

capabilities.verb: Turn your profile into a tailored CV
capabilities.summary: CV Studio builds CVs from templates, from an uploaded CV or one-shot from your profile, with a versioned template bank, design-token editor, ATS lint and five export formats.
proofs: Exports to PDF, DOCX, Markdown, JSON and ATS text; the PDF is the page-count truth
Versions carry diff, image-diff and one-click restore for every AI edit
Live ATS lint and a page-count meter run inside the builder

capabilities.verb: Ask an assistant that edits nothing without your approval
capabilities.summary: A chat grounded in your catalog, profile and postings through tool-calling: profile edits arrive as proposal cards with before/after previews and one-click revert, and a builder copilot operates CV Studio with vision.
proofs: Answers ground in your own data via tool-calling; long runs show a readable progress trace
Profile edits are anchored proposal cards with rendered before/after previews and one-click revert
A read-before-edit gate makes the assistant open an item's full content before proposing edits
The builder copilot sees rendered CV pages and applies validated operations on one audited path
Postings carry short ref ids — ask by board, recency or reference and get Explore deep-links

capabilities.verb: Track every application from applied to offer
capabilities.summary: A board or list runs applied through screening, interview, offer and acceptance, with event timelines, the documents you sent and follow-up reminders on your cadence; stage changes proposed in chat ask first.
proofs: Six stages: applied, screening, interview, offer, accepted, closed — closes record the outcome
Every application keeps an event timeline: stage moves, notes, documents, follow-up snoozes
Follow-up reminders default to +7 and +14 days and arrive through the notification funnel
The dashboard shows the real saved → applied → interviewing → offers funnel
Stage changes proposed in chat land as confirmation cards — the tracker never auto-applies

capabilities.verb: Find openings on live job boards that match your profile
capabilities.summary: Thirteen bundled connectors pull live postings — job boards, career-site feeds, ATS APIs, JSON-LD, RSS, CSV, paste-a-URL — deep extraction makes them auditable data, and Career Autopilot hunts a stated goal on cadence.

capabilities.verb: Tell your radar what you want — sources go search for it
capabilities.summary: Posting sources can follow your job radar instead of their own static config: one focused role-group query per sync, rotating — traffic stays constant however many keywords you set.
proofs: A source marked Follow my radar takes keywords and location from the Job Radar; the form shows the effective query and rotation position
Role groups rotate round-robin — one focused search per sync; optional batches of 2-3 run strictly sequential with jittered pauses
Keywords are grouped by an AI curator into role groups (deterministic auto-merge fallback; un-curated plans upgrade when AI is configured)
A management page per source shows the query plan (per-group timing, per-term provenance), run history with retry, and all configuration
Fetch-detail modes (off / sample / smart / all): smart and all queue paced, budgeted description fetches for the best-ranked postings

capabilities.verb: Map the degree that leads to your target job
capabilities.summary: Upload your university's admission PDF and a parsing pipeline drafts universities, departments and yearly baselines for your review; approved departments link to jobs through pathway rows.
proofs: Parsed admission data lands in the catalog only after you review and approve it
Departments link to jobs with relevance, required subjects, salary bands and employment rates
University intake is gated behind the student career stage — hidden for the other stages

capabilities.verb: Follow a mapped route to the job you want
capabilities.summary: Curated and AI-drafted routes to each job, plus computed routes over the typed relation graph, render as graph, tree or list — fork a curated path into your own copy and activate it after review.

capabilities.verb: Extend the app with your own job sources
capabilities.summary: The connector SDK ships job sources as versioned, consent-gated extensions with trust tiers and sandboxing, and an MCP server exposes read-only-by-default career tools to external clients.
proofs: Imported extensions run out-of-process: sandboxed subprocess or external MCP script
Installs are consent-gated and digest-pinned — they never auto-update
MCP clients read your career data through a locally generated, rotatable token; writes ride approval cards
Bundles install from https git sources — or a zip upload in dev/test — the bundle's own settings form drives config, consent and pinning
A drifted page still yields minimal valid rows the deep-extraction pass structures — typed errors, never a crash

matrix.note: server app; AI + job boards need network
T0–T3 trust tiers; MCP in and out

useCases: Pick a degree with a destination — upload the admission PDF, approve the parsed departments, and follow degree-to-job pathways into a target role.
Delegate the hunt — describe “junior QA role, remote, €30k+” once; Autopilot searches connected boards on cadence and returns a shortlist with reasons.
Re-enter the market — import your old CV or GitHub profile review-first, then ship a tailored CV plus a per-posting cover letter from CV Studio.
Feed the radar, not the boards — add job-board sources, set one salary-floor radar, and get digests only when unseen matches clear it.
Run the pipeline like a pipeline — move cards applied → offer while +7/+14-day follow-up nudges arrive through the notification funnel.
